entries.subject: The colour of the photosphere
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at the published 2,600 K (Inglis et al. 2024, Table 1), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer into sRGB with the D65 white.

entries.subject: A spectrum of this star alone as the colour
entries.finding: Gaia does not resolve this star from ROXs 42B A, so no spectrum or catalogue row of its own exists; the paper temperature gives the colour.
entries.revisitWhen: A spectrum of this star alone is published.

entries.subject: Limb darkening of the sphere
entries.finding: No fit of this star's limb exists, so the sphere is darkened by the quadratic TESS law Claret (2017) computes from PHOENIX model atmospheres at 2,600 K and log g 3.71, from the record's mass and radius: a model. It replaced the uniform disc of the first version.
